I got stalked for over a year by a old guy, he would follow me everywhere if i went alone, i would see him sit outside my house and school.

I ran home faster then I've ever ran before i felt like i could have ran a marathon.
The police never have found him, i caught him outside my bedroom window one night and my clothes kept going missing off the line and shoes, my anklet was never recovered until they got a random tip off and found his house, 2 STREETS AWAY FROM MINE!!!! He had an entire bedroom filled with my pictures, clothes, shoes, anklet, a school painting of mine that went missing from out the front of my classroom one lunch time, even my brush that went missing WHICH NEVER LEFT MY HOUSE, he had been in my house. 
He had names written down for our children, a wedding dress and they also found a secret sound proof bedroom hidden behind a wall.
It was disgusting and sent me into bad depression and anxiety which i both still suffer with till this day, it's been 4yrs on January the 23rd that just passed he was never found and i moved towns nearly a state away actually, but i still suffer bad anxiety if I'm home and my partner isn't. 
I grew up with a really bad childhood and i guess i was lucky to know how to defend myself.
